    BO13a Lemma 8, the final star (step R5) #

    Three morphisms V₁, σ₂', r into a and three V₂, ρ₁', t out of a with σ₂' ≫ V₂ = r ≫ ρ₁' = V₁ ≫ t = 0, whose other six composites form a crown (σ₂, ρ₁, σ₁, ρₙ, μ, ν) of length six (μ = r ≫ t, ν = σ₂' ≫ t), with σ₁ long and ρ₁, ρₙ, ν not long, are impossible (MulBasis.l8_star). Reconstruction: notes/2026-10-30-074207-bo13a-lemma8-reconstruction.md.

    • RayCat.contour_through: a long morphism with a factorization f ≫ g has a contour one of whose paths passes through the middle object.
    • RayCat.contour_first_cross: the first arrow of the other path is incomparable with the first part of that path.
    • MulBasis.l8_gout, MulBasis.l8_gin (and _path forms): figure 8.10 or a D̃₄ star, and the duals.

    BO13a Lemma 8, the final star.
